name: Methi Mathi with Schezwan Dip
ingredients_raw: Baked Methi Mathi: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Hydrogenated Vegetable Fat (Palm Oil, Palmolein), Refined Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil/ Cottonseed Oil/Palmolein), Clarified Butter (Ghee), Iodized Salt, Bishop's Weed, Fenugreek Leaves (0.006%), Black Pepper, Turmeric Powder & Additives (E322, E471, E331, E330, E319). Schezwan Dip: Synthetic Vinegar [Water, Acetic Acid (INS260)], Liquid Glucose, Garlic, Water, Refined Vegetable Oil (Soyabean Oil), Ginger, Red Chillies, Iodized Salt, Spices and Condiments, Sugar, Stabilizers (INS1422, INS415), Onions, Soyabean Sauce [Water, Soyabean, Wheat, Iodized Salt, Acidity Regulators (INS260), Flavor Enhancers (INS627, INS631) and Preservatives (INS202)], Tomato Paste, Flavor Enhancer (INS635), Preservative (INS211) and Antioxidant (INS319).
